item.stem:
Several students were collecting information about how fast cars were driving by their school. The table below shows the results for 20 cars.

| Car | Slow | Medium | Fast |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | | X | |
| 2 | X | | |
| 3 | X | | |
| 4 | | | X |
| 5 | | | X |
| 6 | X | | |
| 7 | | X | |
| 8 | | X | |
| 9 | X | | |
| 10 | X | | |
| 11 | X | | |
| 12 | | X | |
| 13 | X | | |
| 14 | | | X |
| 15 | | | X |
| 16 | X | | |
| 17 | | X | |
| 18 | X | | |
| 19 | | X | |
| 20 | | | X |

To make the results easier to read, the students started to put the information into the bar graph.

Complete the bar graph.

[Image: Bar graph]

descriptors: Both bars correctly drawn. Bar for fast is between 4 and 6 (inclusive). Bar for medium is taller than bar for fast but less than 7.5 (exclusive).
Incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

item.figure_description: An incomplete bar graph titled "Car Speed". The vertical axis is labeled "Number of Cars" with tick marks and numerical labels at 0, 5, and 10. The horizontal axis has tick marks dividing it into three category columns labeled "Slow", "Medium", and "Fast". A single light-gray shaded rectangular bar is drawn in the "Slow" column, reaching a height of approximately 9 (just below the tick mark for 10). The "Medium" and "Fast" columns are currently empty.
item.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics).

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

step1.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's step 1 parameter d1? In the GPCM, b - d1 is the ability at which earning the first point becomes more likely than earning no point, so a higher d1 means that this point is earned at a lower ability; the steps sum to 0. Choose the value closest to it.
